page_title: UDI 2-2 PIS | Udinese v Pisa 10/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Francesco Coppola (Pisa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+4' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Francesco Coppola (Pisa) replacing Arturo Calabresi.
90+4' Oumar Solet (Udinese) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+2' The attendance is 23186.
90+1' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Henrik Meister as he is replaced by Malthe Hojholt (Pisa).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' CHANCE! Keinan Davis (Udinese) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
89' Arthur Atta (Udinese) received a precise low pass and attempted to surprise the keeper with a quick execution. A superb strike only denied by the right post.
88' The corner from Samuele Angori (Pisa) is intercepted by the defence.
85' A pass from Matteo Palma (Udinese) is intercepted by Simone Scuffet and the move breaks down.
84' Henrik Meister (Pisa) is penalised for holding. Giovanni Ayroldi signals a set piece. Udinese get a free kick.
83' Henrik Meister (Pisa) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
81' Iker Bravo (Udinese) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
80' The main referee, Giovanni Ayroldi, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) is given a yellow card for dissent.
80' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) was too forceful with his tackle and Giovanni Ayroldi interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Udinese will take a free kick.
79' Samuele Angori (Pisa) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
78' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. Pisa have been awarded a corner kick.

78' What a great touch by Henrik Meister (Pisa) after latching on to a precise pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and rips a shot close to the right post. The goalkeeper makes an astonishing save, knocking the ball onto the post. Pisa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
77' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
76' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
76' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Pisa have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Oumar Solet (Udinese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iker Bravo (Udinese) comes onto the pitch so that Lennon Miller can be given a rest.
75' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Hassane Kamara will be replaced by Matteo Palma (Udinese).
73' The game is interrupted now, Oumar Solet (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
73' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
67' 2 - 2 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Henrik Meister (Pisa), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 2:2.

67' What a save from Maduka Okoye! Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
65' Yellow card. Stefano Moreo (Pisa) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
63' Samuele Angori (Pisa) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
61' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) replaces Nicolo Zaniolo.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
59' Pisa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) is coming onto the pitch as Marius Marin cannot continue after picking up an injury.
57' It will be a substitution. Idrissa Toure (Pisa) is ready to enter the pitch as Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris walks off.
56' Here is a change. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Arthur Atta (Udinese).
56' Substitution. Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) in, Alessandro Zanoli out.
54' The cross into the penalty area from Hassane Kamara (Udinese) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.

52' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Maduka Okoye displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
51' Pisa produce a short pass from the free kick.
50' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Pisa will take a free kick near the side line.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45+3' A rebound falls kindly for Lennon Miller (Udinese), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
45+3' A raking crossfield pass from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
45+1' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
45+1' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Pisa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
44' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Corner kick. Pisa will have an opportunity.
43' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
40' 2 - 1 Goal! Keinan Davis (Udinese) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Simone Scuffet to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
40' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is going to take the penalty!
38' It’s a PENALTY to Udinese after the VAR review!
37' There's a break in play and referee Giovanni Ayroldi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Udinese using VAR. This could be interesting!
36' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
34' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Marius Marin (Pisa) for his blatant foul.
34' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
33' The resulting set piece from Pisa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
32' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Pisa.
32' A rebound falls at the feet of Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies well wide of the left post.
31' Lennon Miller (Udinese) launches a cross from the corner, but Simone Scuffet is alert to thwart the effort.
31' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
28' The foul by Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) was seen by Giovanni Ayroldi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
27' The linesman raises his flag. Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) is adjudged offside.
25' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
22' An attempted cross from Michel Aebischer (Pisa) is cleared.
19' 1 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
19' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
19' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.
18' This shall not pass! Oumar Solet (Udinese) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
18' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is flagged for offside.
16' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Michel Aebischer tees up Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the top of the net. 0:1.
13' Pisa take a short corner kick.

13' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Maduka Okoye reacts superbly to deny him. We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
11' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
8' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
7' Giovanni Ayroldi blows the whistle, Keinan Davis (Udinese) is penalised for a foul.
4' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lennon Miller (Udinese), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

3' Keinan Davis (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Udinese are going to take it.
2' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) sends a cross into the box, but Maduka Okoye comes off his line to gather the ball.
1' Samuele Angori (Pisa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Udinese will take the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
